description: This file declares the RemoteKeyMintDevice class, which implements the BnKeyMintDevice interface for remote key management in Android's security hardware abstraction layer. It includes method declarations for key operations such as generate, import, delete, and device locking, and references external keymaster implementation.

classes.name: RemoteKeyMintDevice
classes.description: A class implementing the BnKeyMintDevice interface for remote key management, providing methods for key lifecycle management, device security, and cryptographic operations.

methods.name: getHardwareInfo
methods.description: Retrieves hardware information about the keymint device.

methods.name: addRngEntropy
methods.description: Adds entropy to the device's random number generator.

methods.name: generateKey
methods.description: Generates a new cryptographic key with specified parameters.

methods.name: importKey
methods.description: Imports a key with given parameters and data.

methods.name: importWrappedKey
methods.description: Imports a wrapped key with associated metadata.

methods.name: upgradeKey
methods.description: Upgrades an existing key to a new format or version.

methods.name: deleteAllKeys
methods.description: Deletes all keys managed by the device.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Begins a cryptographic operation with specified purpose and parameters.

methods.name: deviceLocked
methods.description: Locks the device, optionally with a timestamp token.

methods.name: earlyBootEnded
methods.description: Indicates that the early boot phase has ended.

methods.name: convertStorageKeyToEphemeral
methods.description: Converts a persistent storage key to an ephemeral key.

methods.name: getKeyCharacteristics
methods.description: Retrieves characteristics of a specified key.

methods.name: getRootOfTrustChallenge
methods.description: Obtains a challenge for root of trust verification.

methods.name: getRootOfTrust
methods.description: Retrieves the root of trust using a challenge.

methods.name: sendRootOfTrust
methods.description: Sends the root of trust data.
